text:
Turbines
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated M6 in the above title block.
This Pump is used to transfer the 
 coolant water to condenser for condensing the steam from turbine to 
 condensate water and also transfer water for closed cooling system
The first draft initiated by eng. Yasser 
 Soliman Rakha, tested by eng. Abed 
 Allah Ebrahim, accepted by eng. 
 Mohamed Hussein and General Manager, 
 revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Abouda EL-Banna,
 and approved by eng: Fawzy Sobhy Ismail Abu 
 Sultan Power Station head sector.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Technical Data:
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolated the circuit breaker of the pump 
 motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the Pump 
 Motor.
Isolate the Pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery valves.
Isolate cooling water for the pump.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Filler, 
 Feeler gauge,
Rags, Grease
Vibrometer, Dial indicator
Lifting equipment.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Operation
Measure Vibration 
 level for bearing and compare it with setting values then analyze it and 
 determine what to do.
Check the discharge, 
 pressure of pump and compare it with the Setting values the replace the worm 
 components.
Check the quantity, 
 pressure of cooling water for bearing of pump and compare it with setting 
 value, and determine what to do.
Pump out of Operation
Check the over heads clearance, and 
 compare it with the Setting values.
Check bolts fixation then re tight it 
 (if it is needed).
Grease the discharge valve of pump 
 (multi- purpose greases).
Check the Leakage from the glands and 
 flanges and treat it.
Repaint the Casing against rust.
Check and readjusted the gland for 
 stuffing box.
Check the flexible joint between 
 discharge head of pump and pipeline for condenser
Check alignment of coupling.
Starting of the Pump
Before 
the Starting the Pump the Fool Awing Steps must be Checked
Open the cooling lines to gland and the 
 quantity of water is sufficient (8 10 GPM).
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
Check the level of sump.
Priming of the pump by filing the tunnel 
 between pump and condenser by screen travel pump.
Check the level of oil in baring of 
 driver.
Open the delivery valve gradually after 
 the pump has been started to operate at its full Speed.
Attends 
and Checking during Operation
Check the discharge, 
 pressure and vibration during operation.
Check the temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.
Check the quantity and 
 pressure for cooling water.
Check the leakage from 
 stuffing box.
